DISABLE ADS

Disable Ads is a script for jailbroken ad-supported Kindles that enables KOReader custom screensavers.

Download

  • Disable ADs

Features

Disable Ads enables KOReader custom screensavers on ad-supported Kindles. Launch it once to switch the device to KOReader’s screensaver pipeline, then manage images directly from KOReader.

Install & Setup

Install through Kindle Forge (recommended): After installing Kindle Forge, hit the download button for DISABLE ADS. It will appear in your documents folder automatically.

Manual:

  1. Download the script from scriptlets.notmarek.com
  2. Copy to Kindle: Place disable_ads.sh in your Kindle's documents folder.
  3. Run the script: On your Kindle, open your library and tap disable_ads.sh to execute it.
  4. Restart your Kindle so KOReader can take over the lock-screen artwork.

Notes

  • This script is required for KOReader custom screensaver and book cover features on ad-supported Kindles.
  • Re-run the script after firmware updates or after toggling Amazon’s stock screensaver settings.
  • Tested on every major jailbroken Kindle model with ads.
